disposition_reason: Resolve Engineering Decision Pending and BLOCKED. NVIDIA NVDEC authority explicitly includes MPEG-2 and separates bitstream decode from later display. FFmpeg provides deterministic probe, hardware-path logging and per-frame signatures. This case can therefore require an immutable MPEG-2 reference covering the project's profile and scan mode, exact no-fallback decoder evidence, complete frame/field/timestamp and golden-output comparison, plus full connector-bound visual inspection. Stream path, GPU selector, golden manifest, display route and threshold values are runtime prerequisites; their absence blocks a run but no longer leaves the review decision undefined.
decision_basis: The exact XLSX row 1785, same-row DeepSeek/test-json content, GPT V2, historical V3.1 record, Round-2 UNRESOLVED result, pending/blocked analyses, ED-01 through ED-30 and official NVIDIA/FFmpeg documentation were read. The next formal identity was directly opened as Functionality row 1786 / Wistron-HW-00419-V002 / 90a3f722bda7a8ad.
MPEG-2 decode and displaying its decoded frames are coherent source stages. The only encode/decode contradiction is in DeepSeek's proposed command, so Source Conflict remains false.

NVIDIA lists MPEG-2 among NVDEC codecs and describes capability query, decoded YUV output and a separate graphics presentation path. Exact device selection and no-fallback proof remain mandatory rather than inferred from family name.

MPEG-2 needs codec-specific bindings absent from the MPEG-1 case: profile/level, chroma, progressive versus interlaced sequence, field order, repeat-first-field/pulldown behavior, sample/display aspect ratio and any deinterlace policy must be recorded in the golden contract.

Objective decode acceptance is an exact approved input hash and metadata, proven hardware path, expected decoded frame/field/timestamp sequence and byte-identical `framemd5` output in a pinned pixel/deinterlace policy, with no parser/decoder error or health regression.

Machine evidence cannot replace the original physical display check. The qualified operator must observe the complete clip for macroblock corruption, combing beyond the approved deinterlace policy, field-order judder, tearing, freeze, crop/aspect error and edge artifacts.
The one-minute Machine Time is not an approved clip duration. Execute the complete configured input or explicit frame range and fail closed if runtime bindings are missing.

test_case.test_name: MPEG-2 hardware decode, field/frame integrity and physical display
test_case.purpose: Validate the approved MPEG-2 bitstream is decoded by the bound hardware path with exact progressive/interlaced frame semantics and completely displayed on the approved connector without codec, field-order, aspect or edge artifacts.
required_package: Immutable known-good MPEG-2 input and SHA-256; approved container, profile/level, chroma, dimensions/rates, progressive/interlaced and field-order/pulldown/aspect metadata
Golden decoded `framemd5`, expected frames/fields/timestamps and pinned output pixel format plus explicit no-deinterlace or approved deinterlace policy
Exact GPU serial/UUID/BDF, OS device selector, driver/VBIOS and ffmpeg/ffprobe build with approved NVDEC hardware path and verbose no-fallback evidence
Bounded non-production scratch/evidence roots and capacity; approved connector/display mode/player/capture route and qualified operator
Baseline/final GPU, thermal/power, Xid/driver, OS/BMC event thresholds and non-destructive recovery
test_case.test_command: PARAMETERIZED REVIEW-LAYER PROCEDURE — do not execute without approved variables. Verify input/golden hashes, scratch containment/capacity, exact GPU identity/capability and healthy baseline while preserving existing logs. Record `ffprobe -v error -show_streams -show_format -show_frames -select_streams v:0 -of json "$MPEG2_INPUT"` and compare the configured profile/level, scan/field order, rates, aspect, duration and frame/field expectations. Record ffmpeg build and available hardware paths. Run `ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel repeat+level+verbose -hwaccel "$APPROVED_HWACCEL" -hwaccel_device "$GPU_SELECTOR" -i "$MPEG2_INPUT" -map 0:v:0 -an -vf "$APPROVED_HW_DOWNLOAD_PIXEL_FORMAT_AND_DEINTERLACE_POLICY" -f framemd5 "$ACTUAL_FRAMEMD5"`. Fail unless logs prove the bound hardware decoder with no fallback and the complete actual manifest/frame-field-timestamp sequence equals the approved golden contract. Then play the same complete input through the approved hardware decode/display route; record connector-bound, time-correlated visual evidence from first through last frame. Collect final health/events. Stop on any mismatch and do not retry.
test_case.expected_result: Approved hashes and MPEG-2 metadata match; the bound hardware decoder is proven with no fallback; every configured frame/field/timestamp and pixel signature matches the golden reference under the specified interlace/deinterlace policy; ffmpeg exits 0 with no parser/decoder error. Complete physical playback has no macroblock corruption, unapproved combing, field-order judder, tearing, freeze, crop/aspect or edge artifact, and final health/events remain within approved limits.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires all automated decode, field/frame, golden and health checks plus the complete qualified visual observation. FAIL on input/metadata mismatch, unsupported decoder, fallback, parser error, missing/extra/reordered frame or field, timestamp/pulldown/deinterlace/pixel mismatch, truncated playback, visual defect, wrong display/GPU, nonzero exit or health/event breach. BLOCKED at runtime—not Engineering Decision Pending—if media/golden values, device/display/operator, package, capacity or thresholds are absent. The end user owns the verdict.
safety_gate: Reject DeepSeek's `mpeg2video` encode-to-null command as decode evidence; bind and prove the exact hardware decoder without fallback.
Verify immutable input/golden hashes and codec-specific scan/field/aspect/deinterlace contract before execution; never silently synthesize or substitute media.
Constrain outputs to the approved scratch/evidence root with preflight capacity; never write production-data paths or truncate coverage to the schedule estimate.
Preserve logs/events; keep deterministic decoded-pixel evidence separate from connector-bound human visual proof.
Stop on decoder/frame/field/timestamp/visual, GPU/driver/Xid, thermal/power, storage or evidence anomaly. Do not retry, reset, reboot, clear logs or change firmware/configuration automatically.
expected_evidence: Approved Source Key/Variant configuration; immutable input/golden hashes; ffprobe stream/frame metadata including profile, scan, field order, pulldown and aspect
Exact GPU/driver/VBIOS/ffmpeg identities, decoder capability/selection and complete no-fallback verbose log
Full exit status, frame/field/timestamp accounting, actual `framemd5` and byte-identical comparison under the approved output/deinterlace policy
Connector/display/mode/player identity and time-correlated full-clip visual photos/video or approved captures with operator checklist
Scratch/capacity proof, preserved pre/during/post health/events, no-retry audit, final state and end-user verdict
test_case.recovery: On the first decoder, field/frame, visual or health failure, stop the approved player/decoder, preserve all media, manifests, logs, captures and events and do not retry. Remove only approved scratch after evidence retention; restore only the approved display/session state without reset, reboot or firmware action. Escalate under the project media/GPU recovery plan if health remains abnormal.
